input.brief: Tell all employees that the remote working policy is changing: from now on staff can work remotely up to three days a week, and remote days must be agreed with their line manager in advance. Link to the full policy.

subject_options: Update to our remote working policy
Remote working policy: what is changing
meta.preheader: Remote working up to three days a week, agreed in advance

blocks.text: We are writing to inform you of an update to our remote working policy, which applies from [[fill: effective date]].

items: You may work remotely for up to three days each week.
Remote days must be agreed with your line manager in advance.

blocks.text: If you have any questions about these changes, please speak to your line manager.
